why: I checked each verifier check against the two must_not items. Item 1 holds: Check 3 lists every exported function, and its FAIL condition names subtract, so a README that documents clamp but not subtract fails. Checks 1, 2 and 4 hold too: Check 1 tests values, Check 2 only needs `instanceof RangeError` with no message match, and Check 4 needs exit 0 with no failing tests. Item 2 is broken in Check 3. Its script only counts a function as documented if README.md has a markdown heading matching `'^#+\\s*'+n+'\\s*\\('`, and PASS needs "missing: none". A README that documents every export some other way, such as in a table, a bullet list or prose, would FAIL. The expect line only says README.md "documents every function math.js exports", so this condition requires a specific README layout and is stricter than its line.
